_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits on the Disbelief band edge in a documented coil; base rate favors HOLD until funding/momentum or F&G clearly breaks the 55-62 range.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative describes selling but does not contradict the coil or force a directional phase jump
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 55-62 and 30d momentum stays ~50-60 with neutral funding
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >70 with rising momentum/funding, or F&G <46 on a vol-led selloff
